title: Electrically controllable superconducting memory effect in UTe<sub>2</sub>
description:
Nature, Published online: 16 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11015-3

Observations of a memory effect in the p-wave superconductor candidate UTe2, which can be controlled by varying the strength and duration of the electrically applied stimuli, are described.
